categoryDescriptions.animator: Animator controller, layers, parameters (AI Animation extension).
categoryDescriptions.assets: AssetDatabase ops — find, get/modify data, prefab stage, material/shader, refresh.
categoryDescriptions.console: Editor console logs — get/clear with severity filter.
categoryDescriptions.editor: Editor application state (play mode) + selection get/set.
categoryDescriptions.gameobject: Hierarchy CRUD: create/destroy/duplicate/find/modify + component add/get/list/modify/destroy + set-parent.
categoryDescriptions.object: Generic UnityEngine.Object read/write — get-data + modify (diff / pathPatches / jsonPatch).
categoryDescriptions.package: UPM package add/remove/search/list. Add/remove deliver via requestId after domain reload.
categoryDescriptions.ping: MCP health probe — call this first to confirm the server is reachable.
categoryDescriptions.reflection: Reflection-first fallback: find type/method/field + invoke. Replaces ~160 dropped specialty tools.
categoryDescriptions.screenshot: Scene view / Game view / Camera / Isolated screenshots.
categoryDescriptions.script: Script read + update-or-create (Roslyn-validated, waits compile via requestId) + delete + execute.
categoryDescriptions.tests: EditMode/PlayMode test runner. Aborts on dirty scenes — save first.
categoryDescriptions.type: Type introspection — JSON schema for an Object type.

categoryFootnotes.scene: **Dirty-scene gate**: `tests-run` aborts on unsaved scenes — save first.
categoryFootnotes.editor: **Compile gate**: `editor-application-set-state` (e.g. enter Play) throws if compile errors exist. Check `console-get-logs` (Error filter) first.
categoryFootnotes.script: **requestId pattern**: `script-update-or-create` / `script-delete` return immediately; final compile result arrives after domain reload (await it).
categoryFootnotes.package: **requestId pattern**: `package-add` / `package-remove` may trigger domain reload — await final result.
categoryFootnotes.reflection: **Reflection-first**: when no domain tool exists (dropped or extension uninstalled), use `reflection-method-find` → `reflection-method-call`. `type-get-json-schema` returns the shape. For one-off editor ops use `script-execute`; for permanent helpers use `script-update-or-create`.
